newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen up on electronics rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen up on electronics rebounds.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were expected to rebound on Thursday led by the star electronic sector, following a tumble of more than 450 points in the previous two sessions, brokers said.
Bellwether electronics, which had lost some 15 percent since late last week, were seen to be among the gain leaders on Thursday, brokers said.

Taiwan's shares fluctuated in volatire trade on Wednesday, with the stock index gaining more than 180 points in early trade but losing steam on heavy profit-taking to finish 169.34 points or 1.77 percent lower at 9,381.06.
A 9,300-9,550 range was seen for Thursday.
"Technical rebounds are expected in the electronic sector following continued drops of the sector since last Thursday," Kuo Ming-kun of Capital Securities said.
The bullish electronics rose well over 100 percent in the first half of 1997, taking firm lead of the market's wider rally, but have consolidated since July 17.
Brokers said electronics have strong fundementals as reflected by their large earnings.
Wall Street's overnight gains should also help sentiment, brokers said. -- Lawrence Chung (886-2-5080815)
